page_title: NOT 0-0 ARS | Nottingham Forest v Arsenal 26/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' Declan Rice (Arsenal) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+4' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Andy Madley who sees an offensive foul.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Callum Hudson-Odoi, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
88' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
87' My Gran could have done better! Thomas Partey (Arsenal) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Martin Odegaard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thomas Partey (Arsenal).
85' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ben White (Arsenal) replacing Jurrien Timber.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) replaces Chris Wood.
84' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
82' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
81' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Nottingham have a free kick.
80' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is penalised for holding. Andy Madley signals a set piece.
80' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
79' The resulting corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Now Arsenal have a corner.
79' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) shows his great vision by switching the play and picking out Oleksandr Zinchenko with a fantastic crossfield pass.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Ethan Nwaneri.
77' One of the Nottingham players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
76' The free kick from Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
76' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
75' Ola Aina (Nottingham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
75' Nottingham are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
74' Declan Rice (Arsenal) produces a cunning chipped pass for Martin Odegaard, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
73' Handball! A player from Nottingham handled the ball. Arsenal are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
72' Nottingham get a corner.
72' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays a terrific long ball forward to Chris Wood, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
71' Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
70' Substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) in, Jorginho out.
70' David Raya pulls off a great save to deny Chris Wood (Nottingham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
69' A free kick is awarded to Nottingham. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
67' Kieran Tierney finds some space and receives a very precise long pass from Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal).
65' Andy Madley has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
65' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

64' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
63' Substitution. Danilo (Nottingham) replaces Nicolas Dominguez.
62' Here is a change. Anthony Elanga is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
61' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Declan Rice (Arsenal) meets a cross inside the box, but Matz Sels wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
59' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is intercepted by Matz Sels.
58' Jorginho (Arsenal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
57' The ball is behind the touchline and Nottingham will take a throw-in.

56' The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick. Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
55' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) will deliver the corner kick.

55' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

53' Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
51' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.

51' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
49' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner but it's cleared.
49' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) sends a chip pass into the box, but Matz Sels is quickest to intercept the ball. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
46' Substitution. Riccardo Calafiori makes his way off the pitch and Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
46' The whistle blows and Andy Madley starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Arsenal spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
43' The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.
42' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
37' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
35' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Mikel Merino (Arsenal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
35' Jorginho (Arsenal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
34' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
34' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andy Madley blows for a foul.
29' Andy Madley blows for a foul after Chris Wood (Nottingham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
27' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
26' One of the Arsenal players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
25' Great touch by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
24' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by William Saliba (Arsenal).
23' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post.
20' Declan Rice (Arsenal) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
20' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Arsenal.
17' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
17' The corner is swung in but Arsenal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
15' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
14' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) sends a long ball in, but David Raya comfortably gathers the ball.
10' Chris Wood (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Arsenal take a short corner kick.
4' The booking goes to Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham).
4' The free kick is taken by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), but ball is cleared.
3' Today's referee Andy Madley rightly decides to book Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) for his harsh tackle.
1' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Andy Madley.
